title: micro-onboard-concierge-5day-tech-culture-checklist
body:
Purpose:
A compact, low-friction 5-day concierge for new individual contributors (ICs) and short-term contractors. Focus: accelerate first-value, reduce context-switch friction for rapid PLG/infra teams.

Scope and audience:
- New ICs (1-6 months expected tenure) and contractors with >2 weeks assignment.
- Not intended for managers or senior leadership onboarding (separate program).

Goals (measurable):
- Day 5: contributor can run a smoke end-to-end workflow and deliver 1 tiny fix or doc update.
- Week 2 outcome: buddy/owner logs 3 pieces of evidence in evidence pocket.
- Reduce first-2-week clarification threads by 30% vs baseline.

Pre-boarding (before day 0) — checklist for concierge team:
[ ] Access granted: GitHub, Slack, Okta, Google Drive, ticket queue read-only
[ ] Hardware shipped / remote setup instructions sent
[ ] Welcome note + short 3-item orientation agenda (what to expect first 5 days)
[ ] Tiny starter task assigned (read + small PR/issue to watch)

Day 0 (first day) — quick schedule (2–4 hours core):
- 15m: welcome by concierge (Slack call) — expectations and empathy check
- 30m: account & access verification (tick off access list)
- 45–60m: targeted walkthrough: repo layout + dev loop for primary team product area (screen share)
- 30m: buddy intro + first tiny task assigned (label: micro-onboard/first-5)
- 10m: logistics: payroll, benefits quick link, who to ping for what

Day 1–2 — momentum and signals to collect:
- Complete tiny task: open a draft PR or comment on issue (required signal)
- Pair 1:30hr session with buddy on debugging flow or local run (schedule in calendar)
- Shadow: one async team standup + read last 3 postmortems or changelogs relevant to repo
- Concierge: confirm dev environment performance baseline (are tests flaky?)

Day 3–4 — autonomy scaffolding:
- Assign micro-impact chore: doc, test, small bug; measure time-to-merge
- 1:1 with engineering lead (20m): set 30-day outcome expectations (list 3 outcomes)
- Invite to routing lists, oncall docs (read-only)
- Concierge: create "evidence pocket" (google doc) and add 3 links: PR, screenshot, short note

Day 5 — milestone + wrap:
- Deliverable: merged PR or accepted doc change OR an annotated issue with proposed solution
- Buddy review: fill quick rubric (see interview-signal matrix)
- Concierge: short retro with new joiner (10m) — friction log + 1 improvement to process
- Flag for product/people ops if any blockers remain >48h

Evidence pocket (what to collect):
- PR/issue link (required)
- Short writeup (2–4 bullet lines) of what they learned
- 1 contextual screenshot or log snippet
- Buddy rating + 1 suggested next task

Micro interview-signal rubric (for quick internal hiring/extension decisions):
Purpose: simple triage after first week to decide extend/confirm/terminate for short contracts or full-time conversion signal. Use a small 0–2 scoring per signal.
Signals (score each 0/1/2):
- Technical flow competency (ran the dev loop locally end-to-end): 0=not,1=partial,2=full
- Problem framing (able to articulate root cause and next steps): 0/1/2
- Team collaboration (asked clarifying Qs, paired effectively): 0/1/2
- Ownership signal (completed micro-task with follow-through): 0/1/2
- Cultural fit (resonates with team values; communicates asynchronously): 0/1/2
Interpretation: total 8–10 = strong consider; 5–7 = keep observing / extend trial; <=4 = escalate to people-ops for decision.

Buddy responsibilities (concise):
- Hold 3 short pairing sessions in first 5 days
- Give actionable review comments (not just nitpicks)
- Add evidence to pocket and write 2-line rationale for score
- Raise blockers early (escalate to concierge)

Handoff to manager at day 5:
- Fill short 'first-week snapshot' form (one para + scores)
- Attach evidence pocket links
- Suggested 30-day outcomes (3 bullets) and permission level for next tasks

Template: first-week snapshot (one paragraph)
- "Summary: joined on DATE as ROLE, completed micro-task X (link). Strengths: A, B. Area to watch: C. Recommend: continue and assign Y OR pause/terminate."

Quick process notes / heuristics (notes to self):
- Keep the program light: 60–120m of synchronous work first day. Most learning should be async.
- Use labels: micro-onboard/* to find candidate tasks and reduce noise in main backlog.
- For remote-first hires, ensure timezone overlap buddy slots exist first 5 days.
- Contractors: gate first invoice on evidence pocket completion for the 5-day milestone (ops rule).

Unresolved questions (to run in next People Ops retro):
- Should we standardize the tiny starter task per team area or keep team-specific?
- What's the SLA for concierge response to blockers (4h/24h)?
- Do we require a manager 1:1 within first 48h or is day 3 sufficient?

Next steps (action items):
[ ] Pilot with Platform Infrastructure hires in March (3 hires)
[ ] Add the onboarding label automation (GH action) to tag tasks on offer acceptance
[ ] Build a lightweight Confluence template for evidence pocket (link in linked_artifacts)

Contact / owner:
- Maya Thompson (people-ops) — maya@redwood.ai — slack @maya.thompson

Appendix: quick checklist (printable)
- Pre-boarding: access, hardware, starter task sent
- Day 0: account checks, repo walkthrough, buddy intro
- Day 1–2: tiny task + pair sessions, standup shadow
- Day 3–4: micro-chore, lead 1:1, evidence pocket created
- Day 5: merged PR or accepted doc, buddy rubric, first-week snapshot

End of doc.
